definition.title: Press Release Stack — project details
definition.information_html:
Provide your business details and links to four finished press release articles for your Press Release Stack. Each release requires its own finished article link.

Do not include passwords, access tokens or customer contact lists. The team will coordinate any account-access invitations separately.

fields.help_html: Include only business contact details approved for publication.
